Description.Name: Dark Khaos
Description.Details:
Darkan K'Haos is one of Clan Ghost Bear's longest serving Khans, earning the title at a young age - even for a Clan warrior - and living past the average life expectancy of Clan trueborn.

In typical Ghost Bear fashion, Darkan K'Haos is slow to anger and almost never makes a rash decision. Rather, he has focused on building Ghost Bear into a formidable force, hoping to one day invade the Inner Sphere.

Clan simulations have constantly shown that under the leadership of Darkan K'Haos, Ghost Bear would become a power rivaling even the strongest of the Great Houses in military might and territory, should an invasion ever take place.
